name: Ezoic Setup
description:
Ezoic Setup is an AI implementation assistant for publishers integrating Ezoic's monetization platform. Ask it how to set up Ezoic on your stack and it answers with grounded, working code — not generic guesses.

What it does:
- Walks you through Ezoic integration end to end: WordPress plugin, Cloudflare, name server integration, and the ez.js JavaScript tag
- Generates copy-paste-ready placeholder code and ad placement snippets for your specific site structure (HTML, React, Next.js, WordPress themes, and more)
- Answers questions about Ads.txt setup, consent management (CMP), site speed, video player embedding, and troubleshooting common integration errors
- Grounded in Ezoic's official integration docs, SDKs, and knowledge base, so answers reflect how the platform actually works today

Who it's for: site owners, developers, and agencies setting up Ezoic ads on a new site or debugging an existing integration.

No account or authentication required to ask questions. The same assistant is available in a browser at https://setup-agent.ezoic.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ezoic Setup to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ezoic Setup to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://setup-agent.ezoic.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Ezoic Setup MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, Ezoic Setup scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Ezoic Setup's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, Ezoic Setup scores 77/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 4 of 4 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ezoic Setup MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ezoic Setup provides these MCP tools: ask, help, read_response, and request_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ezoic Setup?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ezoic Setup in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Ezoic Setup MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ezoic Setup does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
